headline: Kajetan Schweighofer climbs into ARC-2 gold

sections.text: Kajetan Schweighofer rose from 28th to 15th, gaining 11.25 points to reach 47.92 and move into the gold places.
His move put him in the final gold position on the public board; standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
